同配引文图上拓扑被特征/GRACE 吸收，冗余。
§12.1
raw-vs-GRACE		互惠-kNN 构球本身是不是稳定正信号（与表示无关）？raw 特征 vs GRACE 上对比 ordinary GB vs 互惠-kNN 球的 purity/AUROC。raw 上 ordinary GB purity 崩塌（Cora 0.303 / CiteSeer 0.210）；互惠-kNN 恢复到 0.78–0.84；GRACE 上 dcgb purity 0.89 / AUROC 0.79。互惠-kNN 构球=稳定正信号
可靠性来自构球方式，与表示空间/拓扑无关。
§12.3-4
S1 (NoisyGL)		在监督 GCN hidden 上构 reliable 球 + 保守重加权，能否去噪？NoisyGL GCN 宿主，Cora uniform 0.4 seed3000 单 seed smoke；含 no-ball/random 对照（修了 config 覆盖 bug）。reliable-GB test 0.705 = GCN 0.705，best_phase=warmup；gated precision 0.50 = 有效 no-ball 0.50。S1 no-go
工作假设：GCN epoch6 见顶记忆噪声→瓶颈在监督表示，转 label-free 对比表示。
§12.4
S2a Phase1 + headroom		把同一套 reliable 球搬到 frozen GRACE + 软目标/重加权，能否涨点？先测有没有油水。Cora symm 0.4 seed0；ce/gb/dcgb_emb_only/qsafe/topk/shuffled；clean-oracle 测 headroom。headroom = oracle 0.8221 − noisy-CE 0.7878 = 3.43pp（有油水）。但 dcgb 0.7941 = shuffled 0.7941，< gb 0.7962；NCR 多为 0。软目标链路未过
有 headroom 但「球→下游」转化失败；soft-target 不提交决策。
§12.5
S2-redesign-v1		换「提交式」机制：commit-style 样本选择（small-loss × 球可靠性），替换软目标。seed0；每 epoch 选 top-k 信任节点，固定 schedule；方法+6 对照同 schedule，仅 rel 来源不同。seed0 上 sel_dcgb 0.779 碾压 no-ball/shuffled/random（0.66–0.68）；但 sel_gb 0.809 > sel_dcgb > gb_soft。预注册门未过
commit 机制让球信号转化了（机制对）；但 seed0 出现「gb>dcgb」倒挂，记为待验证假设。
§12.6
S3 Phase1		seed0 的「sel_gb > sel_dcgb」倒挂是真的吗？先多 seed 证伪再投入机制解释。Cora symm 0.4 × 5 seed；预注册 A/B/C 机械判定。A（gb>dcgb）1/5、mean −3.00pp；B（gb>gb_soft）2/5；C（dcgb>对照）5/5/5。均值 dcgb 0.8002 > topk 0.7969 > gb 0.7702。seed0 倒挂被证伪
C 成立
reliable 球才是稳的；commit-selection+球稳健。
§12.7
S3 Q2（主线生死）		球结构相对纯 kNN 共识到底多提供了什么？（审稿人会问：粒球=kNN consensus 包装？）复用 5-seed 数据，paired 比较 dcgb vs topk（k 匹配球大小、同覆盖 0.6）。dcgb−topk test +0.327pp、std 1.03pp、t≈0.71 不显著；sel-precision 0/5 输、noise-recall 0/5 输。命中降级档
显式建球相对 kNN 共识无可证独立增量。
§12.8
S3 Phase1c（density）		借 GBmooer：球级密度结构（kNN 共识表达不了）能否拉开 kNN 共识？（先验证角距离=恒等，避免无效实验）新 density 信号 = density(B)×compactness(i,B)×noisy_consensus(B)；5 seed；配 shuffled/random matched。density 0.7714 < topk 0.7969 < dcgb 0.8002；density>topk 1/5、mean −2.56pp；sel-prec/recall 全面更差。density 赢自身 shuffled/random（+5.97/+3.02pp）。预注册否定
球级密度结构被 kNN 共识覆盖且更差；frozen-space「改球」穷尽=没救。
§12.9
S3 Phase2（encoder coupling）		读 CGBC/GBmooer 原文→根因是「表示为球而生+球反馈进 encoder」。最小弱耦合：让表示被球塑造。GRACE init 全 encoder 小 lr 微调 L=L_sup+λ_cl·L_GRACE+λ_gb·L_ball（λ 固定不调）；中间诊断早停门：球质量是否变好。coupled-dcgb purity 0.8856 / AUROC 0.8885 vs frozen 0.8893/0.8920（−0.37/−0.35pp）；coupled = baseline purity ±0.00。log：L_GRACE≈6.84 ≫ intra 0.02/inter 0.2。早停（球质量未改善）
球损失被对比损失淹没；最小弱耦合无效（不否定强耦合）。

一句话主线（读这一段就够）： 课题方向从「图感知粒球」转向「对比表示上的 reliable 粒球去噪」。随后用一连串严格的预注册实验逐一证明： 在「保持 GRACE 表示稳定」的前提下，粒球结构相对最朴素的 kNN 共识没有任何可证的独立增量—— 图感知球、reliable 互惠-kNN 球、density 球、最小弱 encoder-coupling 全部无首信号。 唯一稳健的是「局部一致性可靠性信号 + commit-style 样本选择」，但这与「球」本身无关。 保留粒球作主角只剩「球损失主导的强耦合训练」（CGBC/GBmooer 路线，工程大、与项目 frozen 稳定经验相悖）。

一、实验时间线总表（每一步：思想 / 做法 / 关键结果 / 结论）

编号 算法思想（为什么做） 做法（怎么做） 关键结果（真实数字） 结论 / 判定
§12.1
DCGB 诊断		 导师 idea：图感知粒球（特征+拓扑）是否比纯特征球更好？验证拓扑增量。 Cora/CiteSeer × noise 0.2/0.4 × 5 seed；比较 dcgb（特征+拓扑）vs dcgb_emb_only（纯特征互惠-kNN）的球质量。 拓扑增量 dcgb − emb_only：purity ±0.002、AUROC ±0.001（全 8 条件 ≈0）。 图感知球不作主创新
同配引文图上拓扑被特征/GRACE 吸收，冗余。
§12.1
raw-vs-GRACE		 互惠-kNN 构球本身是不是稳定正信号（与表示无关）？ raw 特征 vs GRACE 上对比 ordinary GB vs 互惠-kNN 球的 purity/AUROC。 raw 上 ordinary GB purity 崩塌（Cora 0.303 / CiteSeer 0.210）；互惠-kNN 恢复到 0.78–0.84；GRACE 上 dcgb purity 0.89 / AUROC 0.79。 互惠-kNN 构球=稳定正信号
可靠性来自构球方式，与表示空间/拓扑无关。
§12.3-4
S1 (NoisyGL)		 在监督 GCN hidden 上构 reliable 球 + 保守重加权，能否去噪？ NoisyGL GCN 宿主，Cora uniform 0.4 seed3000 单 seed smoke；含 no-ball/random 对照（修了 config 覆盖 bug）。 reliable-GB test 0.705 = GCN 0.705，best_phase=warmup；gated precision 0.50 = 有效 no-ball 0.50。 S1 no-go
工作假设：GCN epoch6 见顶记忆噪声→瓶颈在监督表示，转 label-free 对比表示。
§12.4
S2a Phase1 + headroom		 把同一套 reliable 球搬到 frozen GRACE + 软目标/重加权，能否涨点？先测有没有油水。 Cora symm 0.4 seed0；ce/gb/dcgb_emb_only/qsafe/topk/shuffled；clean-oracle 测 headroom。 headroom = oracle 0.8221 − noisy-CE 0.7878 = 3.43pp（有油水）。但 dcgb 0.7941 = shuffled 0.7941，< gb 0.7962；NCR 多为 0。 软目标链路未过
有 headroom 但「球→下游」转化失败；soft-target 不提交决策。
§12.5
S2-redesign-v1		 换「提交式」机制：commit-style 样本选择（small-loss × 球可靠性），替换软目标。 seed0；每 epoch 选 top-k 信任节点，固定 schedule；方法+6 对照同 schedule，仅 rel 来源不同。 seed0 上 sel_dcgb 0.779 碾压 no-ball/shuffled/random（0.66–0.68）；但 sel_gb 0.809 > sel_dcgb > gb_soft。 预注册门未过
commit 机制让球信号转化了（机制对）；但 seed0 出现「gb>dcgb」倒挂，记为待验证假设。
§12.6
S3 Phase1		 seed0 的「sel_gb > sel_dcgb」倒挂是真的吗？先多 seed 证伪再投入机制解释。 Cora symm 0.4 × 5 seed；预注册 A/B/C 机械判定。 A（gb>dcgb）1/5、mean −3.00pp；B（gb>gb_soft）2/5；C（dcgb>对照）5/5/5。均值 dcgb 0.8002 > topk 0.7969 > gb 0.7702。 seed0 倒挂被证伪
C 成立
reliable 球才是稳的；commit-selection+球稳健。
§12.7
S3 Q2（主线生死）		 球结构相对纯 kNN 共识到底多提供了什么？（审稿人会问：粒球=kNN consensus 包装？） 复用 5-seed 数据，paired 比较 dcgb vs topk（k 匹配球大小、同覆盖 0.6）。 dcgb−topk test +0.327pp、std 1.03pp、t≈0.71 不显著；sel-precision 0/5 输、noise-recall 0/5 输。 命中降级档
显式建球相对 kNN 共识无可证独立增量。
§12.8
S3 Phase1c（density）		 借 GBmooer：球级密度结构（kNN 共识表达不了）能否拉开 kNN 共识？（先验证角距离=恒等，避免无效实验） 新 density 信号 = density(B)×compactness(i,B)×noisy_consensus(B)；5 seed；配 shuffled/random matched。 density 0.7714 < topk 0.7969 < dcgb 0.8002；density>topk 1/5、mean −2.56pp；sel-prec/recall 全面更差。density 赢自身 shuffled/random（+5.97/+3.02pp）。 预注册否定
球级密度结构被 kNN 共识覆盖且更差；frozen-space「改球」穷尽=没救。
§12.9
S3 Phase2（encoder coupling）		 读 CGBC/GBmooer 原文→根因是「表示为球而生+球反馈进 encoder」。最小弱耦合：让表示被球塑造。 GRACE init 全 encoder 小 lr 微调 L=L_sup+λ_cl·L_GRACE+λ_gb·L_ball（λ 固定不调）；中间诊断早停门：球质量是否变好。 coupled-dcgb purity 0.8856 / AUROC 0.8885 vs frozen 0.8893/0.8920（−0.37/−0.35pp）；coupled = baseline purity ±0.00。log：L_GRACE≈6.84 ≫ intra 0.02/inter 0.2。 早停（球质量未改善）
球损失被对比损失淹没；最小弱耦合无效（不否定强耦合）。

二、核心对比：commit-style 选择下各信号的 5-seed 均值（Cora symm 0.4）

同一 commit-style selection 机制（固定 schedule W20/ramp20/ρ=0.6），唯一差别是可靠性信号 rel 的来源。这是判定「球 vs kNN 共识」的核心证据表。

信号rel 来源testselection precisionnoise-excl recall角色
sel_clean_oraclenoisy==clean（上限）0.81431.00001.0000诊断上限
sel_dcgb_emb互惠-kNN reliable 球0.80020.90400.8562球（候选主角）
sel_topk_matched纯 kNN 共识（无球）0.79690.92250.8839对照：朴素局部一致性
sel_density_gb球级密度结构0.77140.80700.6654球（GBmooer 式）
sel_gbordinary GB 共识0.77020.80020.5889对照（seed0 曾误判为更优）
sel_random_density_matched打乱球（随机）0.74120.75090.5088对照：破坏结构
sel_shuffled_density_matched打乱球（shuffle）0.71170.68550.3032对照：破坏结构
sel_noball仅 loss（无任何球/共识）0.70820.68860.3207对照：纯 small-loss

读法： ① dcgb 0.8002 ≈ topk 0.7969（差 0.33pp，t≈0.71 不显著），而 topk 的 selection-precision/noise-recall 反而更高 → 球 ≈ kNN 共识。 ② 所有「有结构」的信号（dcgb/topk）都远超「破坏结构」的 shuffled/random/noball（差 8–9pp）→ 局部一致性结构有用，但「球」不是其中的独立成分。 ③ density、gb 都不如 topk → 更复杂的球设计没带来增量。

三、贯穿全程的机制结论（为什么粒球在 frozen 表示上不转化）

主题结论证据
表示 vs 球frozen GRACE 不是「为球而生」的表示；球的几何与分类器学的是同一套，信息冗余 → 任何球结构退化成局部 kNN 共识。§12.7 dcgb≈topk；§12.8 density<topk
转化环节瓶颈不在球质量/去噪公式/时机，而在「转化」：软目标不提交决策（NCR≈0），commit-style 选择能转化但转化的是「局部一致性」不是「球」。§12.4 headroom 3.43pp 但 dcgb=shuffled；§12.5 commit 机制生效
group-purity 的误导group 级 clean-purity 分不出 gb 与 dcgb（0.892 vs 0.893），但 node 级 selection precision 区分得出 → 球质量指标会骗人。§12.7
弱耦合不足最小弱耦合中球损失被 L_GRACE 量级淹没（0.02 vs 6.84），球质量零改善；coupled=baseline。§12.9
CGBC/GBmooer 为何有效它们球损失是一等主导损失（CGBC L=L_clustering+L_SCE、GBmooer 超球对比专为球可分），表示被球塑造，代价是放弃 frozen 稳定性、接近从头训。任务也非图节点（合约/文本，i.i.d. 样本）。原文核对 2603.27734v1 / ssrn-6022343

四、全程严守的科研护栏（这也是结论可信的原因）

① clean label 只用于评估/诊断，绝不进构球/可疑度/门控/权重/教师/目标/损失（已单测）。
② 不做 hard same-ball positive、不做 GB view generation、不做 prototype/center pulling。
③ 每个 claim 必须带 no-ball + random/shuffled size-matched 对照，且同覆盖、同 schedule。
④ 不 threshold/formula-shopping（不为过线调 alpha/gate/top_ratio/λ/schedule）。
⑤ 不从单 seed、不从 within-std 判成功；倒挂/涨点先多 seed 证伪再投入机制解释（§12.5→§12.6 即活例）。
⑥ 两条 protocol 不混报：minival（ratio-split / symmetric / seed 0–4）≠ NoisyGL（uniform+pair / seed 3000–3004）。
⑦ 每步先 seed0 冒烟/中间诊断早停，通过才扩 5 seed。

五、当前位置与两条可选方向（待你决策）

方向内容风险 / 评估
方向 1
高风险		 强耦合 / 球损失主导训练：真正复刻 CGBC/GBmooer，让球的 intra/inter/聚类损失成为主导项，允许表示大幅偏离 GRACE。粒球翻身唯一剩下的技术机会。 工程量最大、最不稳；放弃项目最稳的 frozen 基础；图节点同配性可能仍是额外阻力。先验不乐观。需严格预注册 + 硬止损。
方向 2
证据支持		 诚实主线：「局部一致性可靠性信号 + commit-style 选择」为方法主体（Phase1 的 C 满分本身站得住），粒球为一种实现；外加一条「为何 frozen 表示下球结构不转化 / 弱耦合不足 / 需球损失主导」的负结果机制分析。 所有证据支持；对「研究粒球」的课题组而言是诚实且可发表的机制贡献；不是放弃粒球，是把它放到证据支持的位置。

Claude 的诚实建议：倾向方向 2——「frozen + 改球/弱耦合」这条路已被 8–9 个严格实验走到头；方向 1 是孤注一掷。但若导师坚持粒球为头号卖点，方向 1 也可做，会带硬止损。

C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\实验8去噪5.19-\01_literature_and_research_map.md-2607-1. 两篇论文都采用“先用 contrastive learning 改善表示，再让 GB 在较稳定表示空间中工作”的顺序。这直接支持本项目停止在训练早期不稳定 `z` 上强行构球，优先做 warm-up / EMA / hypersphere / angular-distance 的构球稳定性诊断。
C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\实验8去噪5.19-\01_literature_and_research_map.md:2608:2. 两篇论文中的 GB 主要承担鲁棒训练缓冲层：CGBC 用 GB center / majority label 缓解智能合约 noisy label，GBmooer 用球内 label distribution 做局部 smoothing。迁移到 GRACE 时，不能使用标签，只能转成 label-free confidence、局部降权、关系一致性或噪声场景诊断。
C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\实验8去噪5.19-\01_literature_and_research_map.md:2609:3. GBmooer 的 angle distance、unit hypersphere、average angular distance 对本项目很有启发：下一轮应比较 Euclidean / cosine / angular ball，在 encoder warm-up embedding 上记录球数、半径、平均角距离、跨 seed/epoch 成员稳定性和 relation matrix 稳定性。
C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\实验8去噪5.19-\01_literature_and_research_map.md:2610:4. CGBC 的 supervised purity、majority-vote GB label、same-label inter-GB center pulling 是有监督噪声分类机制，不能进入无监督 GRACE 预训练。它只能启发 label-free purity proxy，例如半径、密度、中心距离、边界距离、跨 epoch 稳定性、同视图/跨视图关系一致性。
C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\实验8去噪5.19-\01_literature_and_research_map.md-2611-5. 两篇论文更支持“noisy-label / noisy-relation robustness”叙事，而不是 clean graph 小幅涨点叙事。后续 RDCL 或 GB-FN 如果继续推进，应优先测试 noisy graph、强增强、边扰动或 label-free noisy-relation setting。

511	### 4.2 Core Problem
512	
513	智能合约漏洞检测数据常由开源工具或静态分析器标注，标签噪声会削弱 DNN 检测模型。CGBC 的核心问题是：如何先用无监督对比学习得到更可聚类的合约表示，再用粒球层生成粗粒度表示和 majority-vote 标签，以降低噪声标签对微调训练的影响。
514	
515	### 4.3 Method Structure
516	
517	- 输入：原始智能合约 `C` 及语义保持增强合约 `C~`；微调阶段输入带标签合约 embedding 和 noisy label
518	- 编码器：多层 Transformer contract encoder；对比预训练阶段使用共享权重双分支 encoder 和 predictor MLP，威胁有效性部分说明实现参考 SimSiam
519	- 对比对象：原始合约和语义保持增强合约的表示
520	- 正样本定义：同一合约的原始版本与增强版本
521	- 负样本定义：无显式负样本；stop-gradient + cosine symmetric loss
522	- 增强：生成不改变功能语义的智能合约代码片段并插入函数；用 IR core operation sequence 的 SHA256 digest 验证语义一致性；PDF 报告 1,000 对样本语义相似率 99.60%，Jaccard diversity 在阈值 0.9 时为 49.49%，阈值 0.95 时超过 74.03%
523	- loss：预训练使用 symmetric cosine contrastive loss；微调使用 `L = L_clustering + L_SCE`，其中 `L_clustering` 包含 intra-GB compactness loss 和 inter-GB looseness loss，`L_SCE` 为 symmetric cross entropy
524	- 是否使用 prototype / cluster / subgraph / view / mask / confidence：使用 augmented view、GB center、GB majority-vote label、supervised purity、coarse-grained representation；不使用图 subgraph；confidence 主要体现为 label purity / GB quality，但依赖标签
525	
526	### 4.4 Granular Ball Related Points
527	
528	- 局部结构建模：在合约 embedding 空间中把相似合约聚成 GB
529	- 聚类或原型：GB center 作为一组样本的粗粒度表示
530	- 样本可信度：使用 supervised `Purity(X)`，即 GB 内 majority label 占比
531	- 邻域选择：通过 cosine distance 找最远锚点并递归二分
532	- 噪声过滤：用 GB center 和 majority-vote label 替代组内样本表示/标签，降低少数 noisy labels 的影响
533	- 多粒度表示：是，粒球数量和大小自适应，不预设固定簇数
534	- Deep learning integration point：GBC layer 位于 encoder layer 和 classifier layer 之间
535	- Representation learning role：contrastive pretraining 让相似合约表示更接近，从而辅助后续粒球聚类
536	- Robust training role：SCE + GB 粗粒度标签校正 + intra/inter GB clustering loss 面向 noisy label robustness
537	
538	### 4.5 Inspiration for This Project
539	
540	CGBC 对本项目最有价值的启发不是照搬 supervised GB label correction，而是提示“先用对比学习 warm-up 表示，再生成粒球”的顺序可能比训练早期直接构造粒球更稳定。它还支持把粒球作为 robust local structure prior 和 noisy-label / noisy-relation 缓冲层，而不是直接把每个节点的 noisy relation 放进主 loss。
541	
542	对 GRACE + 粒球而言，可迁移为三类低风险设计：第一，先在 GRACE warm-up 后的 encoder embedding 中离线诊断粒球质量；第二，用 label-free confidence proxy 替代 supervised purity；第三，优先在噪声边、强增强或伪标签不确定场景检验粒球鲁棒性，而不是只追 clean graph 小幅涨点。
543	
544	### 4.6 Why It Cannot Be Directly Copied to GRACE plus Granular Ball
545	
546	CGBC 是有监督智能合约漏洞检测，不是无监督节点级图对比学习。它的关键 GB 质量指标 `Purity(X)` 直接使用标签，GB label 也来自 majority vote；这些机制如果进入 GRACE 预训练会造成 label leakage。其 inter-GB loss 还按 label 拉近同类 GB center、推远异类 GB center，直接迁移会变成强监督 prototype pulling，与本项目已知失败模式冲突。
547	
548	### 4.7 Relation to Existing Failed Experiments
549	
550	- 解释已有失败实验：支持“训练早期 embedding 不稳定会影响粒球质量”的担忧，也解释为什么直接 GB view generation 或 direct relation regularization 容易失效。
551	- 支持继续某个方向：支持 contrastive warm-up 后再构造粒球、robust/noisy setting、confidence-weighted soft relation 和 label-free purity proxy。
552	- 提示某个方向应该放弃：不支持把 supervised purity、majority-vote GB label、same-label GB center pulling 原样用于无监督 GRACE。
553	
554	### 4.8 Experimental Hypotheses
555	
556	- H1：在 GRACE warm-up 后生成粒球，比从训练初期动态生成粒球更稳定。
557	- H2：label-free confidence proxy 如果能近似 CGBC 中的 supervised purity 作用，可降低错误 same-ball relation 对 loss 的污染。
558	- H3：粒球信号在噪声边、强增强或伪标签不确定场景中的收益，应比 clean graph 标准设置更容易稳定出现。
559	
560	### 4.9 Implementation Difficulty
561	
562	- 代码改动成本：中到高
563	- 计算成本：中到高；原文使用四张 Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB，且所有结果为 5 次独立运行平均
564	- 复现风险：高；PDF 未提供代码链接，且任务、数据和模型栈与 GRACE 差异大
565	- 是否适合下一轮实验：暂缓直接复现；适合作为 warm-up + 粒球稳定性诊断 + 噪声鲁棒性实验的设计依据
566	
567	### 4.10 Important Formula or Pseudocode
568	
569	```text
570	# contrastive pretraining
571	z = F1(C)
572	z_tilde = F2(augment_semantic_preserving(C))
573	p = P(z)
574	p_tilde = P(z_tilde)
575	L_CL = 0.5 * (L_cos(p, stopgrad(z_tilde)) + L_cos(p_tilde, stopgrad(z)))
576	
577	# supervised GB training in CGBC
578	GBs = adaptive_split_by_cosine_distance(embeddings, labels, purity_threshold)
579	center_GB = mean(embeddings_in_GB)
580	label_GB = majority_vote(labels_in_GB)
581	L = L_intra_GB_compactness + L_inter_GB_looseness + L_SCE
582	
583	# safer GRACE adaptation idea
584	h = encoder_after_warmup(view)
585	GBs = build_label_free_balls(h)
586	confidence = f(radius, density, size, center_distance, epoch_stability)
587	loss = grace_loss + lambda * confidence_weighted_soft_relation_loss
588	```
589	
590	### 4.11 Final Value Judgment
591	
592	- 价值：中到高
593	- 理由：它是明确的“contrastive learning + granular-ball robust training”论文，证明 CL warm-up 与 GB 粗粒度鲁棒训练可以互补；但其核心 purity、majority label 和 inter-class separation 都依赖标签，只能提供机制启发，不能直接作为无监督 GRACE 方法依据。
594	
595	## Paper: GBmooer: Granular-ball Text Label Smoothing with Hypersphere Contrastive Learning
596	
597	### 4.1 Basic Information
598	
599	- 年份：2026 SSRN preprint；PDF metadata 显示创建时间 2025-12，修改时间 2026-01；页脚标注 `Preprint not peer reviewed`
600	- 领域：粒球 + 对比学习 + NLP 噪声标签鲁棒训练
601	- 任务：text classification under label noise
602	- 数据集：TREC、AGNEWS、IMDB、Chnsenticorp
603	- 是否节点级：否
604	- 是否图级：否
605	- 是否有代码：Unknown
606	- 代码是否可直接复现：Unknown；论文声明 data available on request
607	- 本地来源：`C:/Users/Admin/Downloads/ssrn-6022343 (1).pdf`
608	
609	### 4.2 Core Problem
610	
611	文本标签噪声会使深度模型过拟合错误 feature-label mapping。传统全局 label smoothing 依赖预训练模型的一次性全局平滑，可能累积错误。GBmooer 的核心问题是：先让高维文本表示更适合聚成局部一致的粒球，再把 label smoothing 限制在局部粒球内，降低噪声扩散范围。
612	
613	### 4.3 Method Structure
614	
615	- 输入：带噪声标签的文本分类训练集
616	- 编码器：BERT 作为主要 encoder；迁移实验还包括 LSTM、TextCNN、GRU
617	- 对比对象：原始文本样本、文本增强得到的 positive samples、batch 内其他样本
618	- 正样本定义：同一样本经 synonym replacement、word order shuffling、random word deletion 等增强得到的视图
619	- 负样本定义：batch 内其他样本；具体 hard negative 策略 Unknown
620	- 增强：文本 token 级增强，包括同义词替换、词序打乱、随机删词
621	- loss：hypersphere angular contrastive loss、KL label smoothing loss、symmetric KL prediction consistency loss
622	- 是否使用 prototype / cluster / subgraph / view / mask / confidence：使用 hypersphere projection、granular-ball clustering、GB center/radius/quality、局部 label distribution；未发现显式 node/subgraph 机制
623	
624	### 4.4 Granular Ball Related Points
625	
626	- 局部结构建模：在对比预训练后的 hypersphere 表示空间中生成局部高密度粒球
627	- 聚类或原型：粒球作为局部 normal prototype，包含 center 和 radius
628	- 样本可信度：粒球质量由 average angular distance 描述，可转成无标签 confidence proxy；论文中 smoothing 仍依赖球内标签分布
629	- 邻域选择：通过角距离和二分 split 形成局部样本集合
630	- 噪声过滤：不是直接删除噪声，而是在每个粒球内部做局部 soft label smoothing
631	- 多粒度表示：是，粒球通过迭代 split 形成多粒度局部区域
632	- Deep learning integration point：contrastive pretraining 后生成粒球，再用粒球局部标签分布指导 fine-tuning
633	- Representation learning role：contrastive learning 先优化表示，使同类更近、异类更分离，从而提高后续 GBC 质量
634	- Robust training role：把噪声影响限制在局部粒球，避免全局 label smoothing 的错误传播
635	
636	### 4.5 Inspiration for This Project
637	
638	GBmooer 对本项目最有价值的启发不是“球内样本可直接共享标签”，而是两点：第一，先用 contrastive warm-up / hypersphere normalization 改善表示空间，再评估粒球稳定性；第二，把粒球质量、角半径、中心距离和球内分布差异作为 soft confidence，而不是只用 same-ball membership。对 GRACE 可迁移为 encoder embedding 或 weak-view embedding 上的 angle-space ball diagnostic。
639	
640	### 4.6 Why It Cannot Be Directly Copied to GRACE plus Granular Ball
641	
642	GBmooer 是有标签文本分类和噪声标签学习，不是无监督节点级 GCL。它的 label smoothing 明确使用球内标签分布，如果直接迁移到 GRACE 会造成 label leakage。文本增强、BERT fine-tuning 和 KL classification objective 也不等价于图增强、InfoNCE 和节点级 linear evaluation。因此只能迁移“表示预热后建球、角距离质量、局部软化/降权”的思想，不能迁移监督标签平滑本身。
643	
644	### 4.7 Relation to Existing Failed Experiments
645	
646	- 解释已有失败实验：支持“直接 same-ball hard positive / prototype pulling 风险高”的判断；GBmooer 自身也没有把 majority label 作为硬替换，而是使用 soft label distribution
647	- 支持继续某个方向：支持 contrastive warm-up 后的粒球稳定性诊断、node-to-ball confidence、local denoising / confidence weighting
648	- 提示某个方向应该放弃：不支持把球内多数类、球内标签一致性或球内 membership 原样迁移为 GRACE 训练标签
649	
650	### 4.8 Experimental Hypotheses
651	
652	- H1：在 GRACE warm-up encoder embedding 上建 hypersphere / angle-distance 粒球，比 raw feature 或 projector output 更稳定。
653	- H2：average angular distance、radius margin、center distance 可作为无标签 confidence，比 hard same-ball membership 更安全。
654	- H3：如果粒球只在噪声边/强增强场景中提供稳定收益，应把论文 claim 限定为 robust local structure prior，而不是 clean graph 通用提升。
655	
656	### 4.9 Implementation Difficulty
657	
658	- 代码改动成本：中
659	- 计算成本：中；需要额外 warm-up 表示抽取、angle-space clustering 和跨 epoch/seed 稳定性诊断

- 计算成本：中到高；原文使用四张 Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB，且所有结果为 5 次独立运行平均

### 4.10 Important Formula or Pseudocode

z = F1(C)
z_tilde = F2(augment_semantic_preserving(C))
p = P(z)
p_tilde = P(z_tilde)
L_CL = 0.5 * (L_cos(p, stopgrad(z_tilde)) + L_cos(p_tilde, stopgrad(z)))

# supervised GB training in CGBC
GBs = adaptive_split_by_cosine_distance(embeddings, labels, purity_threshold)
center_GB = mean(embeddings_in_GB)
label_GB = majority_vote(labels_in_GB)
L = L_intra_GB_compactness + L_inter_GB_looseness + L_SCE

# safer GRACE adaptation idea

## Paper: GBmooer: Granular-ball Text Label Smoothing with Hypersphere Contrastive Learning

### 4.1 Basic Information

- 年份：2026 SSRN preprint；PDF metadata 显示创建时间 2025-12，修改时间 2026-01；页脚标注 `Preprint not peer reviewed`
- 领域：粒球 + 对比学习 + NLP 噪声标签鲁棒训练
- 任务：text classification under label noise

- 是否节点级：否

- 是否有代码：Unknown
- 代码是否可直接复现：Unknown；论文声明 data available on request
- 本地来源：`C:/Users/Admin/Downloads/ssrn-6022343 (1).pdf`

### 4.2 Core Problem

文本标签噪声会使深度模型过拟合错误 feature-label mapping。传统全局 label smoothing 依赖预训练模型的一次性全局平滑，可能累积错误。GBmooer 的核心问题是：先让高维文本表示更适合聚成局部一致的粒球，再把 label smoothing 限制在局部粒球内，降低噪声扩散范围。

### 4.3 Method Structure

- 输入：带噪声标签的文本分类训练集
- 编码器：BERT 作为主要 encoder；迁移实验还包括 LSTM、TextCNN、GRU
- 对比对象：原始文本样本、文本增强得到的 positive samples、batch 内其他样本
- 正样本定义：同一样本经 synonym replacement、word order shuffling、random word deletion 等增强得到的视图
- 负样本定义：batch 内其他样本；具体 hard negative 策略 Unknown
- 增强：文本 token 级增强，包括同义词替换、词序打乱、随机删词
- loss：hypersphere angular contrastive loss、KL label smoothing loss、symmetric KL prediction consistency loss
- 是否使用 prototype / cluster / subgraph / view / mask / confidence：使用 hypersphere projection、granular-ball clustering、GB center/radius/quality、局部 label distribution；未发现显式 node/subgraph 机制

### 4.4 Granular Ball Related Points

- 局部结构建模：在对比预训练后的 hypersphere 表示空间中生成局部高密度粒球
- 聚类或原型：粒球作为局部 normal prototype，包含 center 和 radius
- 样本可信度：粒球质量由 average angular distance 描述，可转成无标签 confidence proxy；论文中 smoothing 仍依赖球内标签分布
- 邻域选择：通过角距离和二分 split 形成局部样本集合
- 噪声过滤：不是直接删除噪声，而是在每个粒球内部做局部 soft label smoothing
- 多粒度表示：是，粒球通过迭代 split 形成多粒度局部区域
- Deep learning integration point：contrastive pretraining 后生成粒球，再用粒球局部标签分布指导 fine-tuning
- Representation learning role：contrastive learning 先优化表示，使同类更近、异类更分离，从而提高后续 GBC 质量
- Robust training role：把噪声影响限制在局部粒球，避免全局 label smoothing 的错误传播

### 4.5 Inspiration for This Project

GBmooer 对本项目最有价值的启发不是“球内样本可直接共享标签”，而是两点：第一，先用 contrastive warm-up / hypersphere normalization 改善表示空间，再评估粒球稳定性；第二，把粒球质量、角半径、中心距离和球内分布差异作为 soft confidence，而不是只用 same-ball membership。对 GRACE 可迁移为 encoder embedding 或 weak-view embedding 上的 angle-space ball diagnostic。

### 4.6 Why It Cannot Be Directly Copied to GRACE plus Granular Ball

GBmooer 是有标签文本分类和噪声标签学习，不是无监督节点级 GCL。它的 label smoothing 明确使用球内标签分布，如果直接迁移到 GRACE 会造成 label leakage。文本增强、BERT fine-tuning 和 KL classification objective 也不等价于图增强、InfoNCE 和节点级 linear evaluation。因此只能迁移“表示预热后建球、角距离质量、局部软化/降权”的思想，不能迁移监督标签平滑本身。

### 4.7 Relation to Existing Failed Experiments

- 解释已有失败实验：支持“直接 same-ball hard positive / prototype pulling 风险高”的判断；GBmooer 自身也没有把 majority label 作为硬替换，而是使用 soft label distribution
- 支持继续某个方向：支持 contrastive warm-up 后的粒球稳定性诊断、node-to-ball confidence、local denoising / confidence weighting
- 提示某个方向应该放弃：不支持把球内多数类、球内标签一致性或球内 membership 原样迁移为 GRACE 训练标签

### 4.8 Experimental Hypotheses

- H1：在 GRACE warm-up encoder embedding 上建 hypersphere / angle-distance 粒球，比 raw feature 或 projector output 更稳定。
- H2：average angular distance、radius margin、center distance 可作为无标签 confidence，比 hard same-ball membership 更安全。
- H3：如果粒球只在噪声边/强增强场景中提供稳定收益，应把论文 claim 限定为 robust local structure prior，而不是 clean graph 通用提升。

### 4.9 Implementation Difficulty

- 代码改动成本：中
- 计算成本：中；需要额外 warm-up 表示抽取、angle-space clustering 和跨 epoch/seed 稳定性诊断

### 11.1 本轮新增核心判断

这两篇论文共同支持一个更强的判断：

> 直接在原始特征 `X` 或普通 GRACE 当前表示 `z` 上构粒球，风险很高；更合理的路线是先通过 contrastive / hypersphere / warm-up / EMA 学出更适合构球的表示空间，再让粒球以 confidence、local consistency、weak prototype 或 compactness regularizer 的形式进入训练目标。

对已有实验的解释是：

- 之前的粒球不是完全“一次生成就不管”，因为很多配置会 periodic refresh。
- 但粒球结构本身没有被 loss 直接优化；它更多是外部规则生成器。
- 因此粒球会随 `z` 间接变化，但没有被明确要求变得更紧凑、更分离、更稳定或更适合去噪。
- 这能解释为什么 same-ball / cross-ball 规则在 view、negative、edge weight 上效果弱甚至伤害 clean graph。

### 11.2 Paper Note: GBmooer

**论文定位**：文本噪声标签分类中的 Granular-ball Text Label Smoothing with Hypersphere Contrastive Learning。

**核心机制**：

- 先用 hypersphere contrastive learning 整理文本表示空间。
- 将 embedding 投影到 unit hypersphere，用 angular distance 衡量局部关系。
- 再在该空间中做 unsupervised granular-ball clustering。
- 球内 label distribution 用于 local label smoothing，避免全局 smoothing 扩散噪声。
- 损失包括 angular contrastive loss、KL smoothing loss 和 symmetric KL consistency。

**对本项目最有价值的启发**：

- 不要直接相信 raw embedding 或 early `z` 的欧氏距离。
- 可以比较 `X`、early `z`、late `z`、EMA `z`、normalized/angular `z` 的构球质量。
- `average angular distance`、`radius`、`temporal stability` 可以作为无标签 confidence。
- 球内 label distribution smoothing 不能直接搬到 GRACE，因为会引入标签信息；只能改写成无标签的 local uncertainty、loss weight 或 relation consistency。

**对失败实验的解释**：

- hard same-ball positive 风险高，因为 same-ball 不等于 same-label。
- full-ball suppression 太粗，因为球内可能混入语义不一致节点。
- 如果普通 GRACE `z` 没有被训练成适合构球的空间，那么基于它的 hard rule 很容易变成噪声规则。

### 11.3 Paper Note: CGBC

**论文定位**：噪声标签下的智能合约漏洞检测，方法是 Contrastive Learning-Enhanced Granular-ball Training。

**核心机制**：

- 先做 unsupervised contrastive representation initialization。
- 再在 encoder 与 classifier 之间加入 GBC layer。
- 用标签 purity 构造 eligible GB，并生成 GB center / majority label。
- 训练中使用 intra-GB compactness、inter-GB looseness / separation 和 symmetric cross entropy。

**对本项目最有价值的启发**：

- GB 不只是外部规则，而是训练目标的一部分。
- 训练目标明确要求球内更紧、球间更分离，粒球结构才会随训练朝“更好”方向变化。
- 迁移到 GRACE 时可以保留 compactness / weak prototype 思路，但必须去监督化。
- GB center 只能作为 `stopgrad` weak prototype，小权重、late enable、高置信球限定，不应替代节点表示。

**不能直接迁移的部分**：

- `Purity(X)`。
- majority-vote GB label。
- same-label inter-GB separation。
- 任何依赖训练标签的球质量判断。

这些机制在 CGBC 中合理，因为它是有监督噪声标签分类；在无监督 GRACE 预训练中会造成 label leakage。

Now I have a thorough picture. Let me give you a detailed analysis of your three questions.

---

## 回答你的三个问题

### Q2 先答（因为它是 Q1 和 Q3 的基础）：CGBC 和 GBmooer 的粒球到底提供了什么额外信号？

两篇论文的粒球之所以有效，**不是因为球本身编码了什么 kNN 共识以外的结构信息**，而是因为它们的训练架构让球成为了 loss 的一等公民，反过来塑造了表示空间。具体来说：

**CGBC（智能合约漏洞检测）**：
- 粒球层插在 encoder 和 classifier 之间，用 `L = L_intra_compactness + L_inter_looseness + L_SCE`
- `L_intra` 要求球内样本更紧凑，`L_inter` 要求不同球中心更分离
- 关键：这两个损失**直接反向传播到 encoder**，所以表示空间被训练成"适合构球"的样子
- 另外，它用 supervised purity + majority-vote label 做粗粒度标签校正，把噪声标签的影响从单样本级缓冲到球级

**GBmooer（文本噪声标签分类）**：
- 先用 hypersphere contrastive learning 把表示投影到单位超球面
- 在这个角距离空间中构球，球内 label distribution 做局部 soft label smoothing
- 损失包含 angular contrastive loss + KL smoothing loss + symmetric KL consistency
- 关键同上：**encoder 被训练成产生适合在超球面上构球的表示**

**两篇论文粒球提供的"额外信号"本质上是三件事**：
1. **粗粒度标签校正**（majority vote / local label distribution）——但这依赖监督标签，你不能用
2. **结构约束反馈到 encoder**（intra compactness / inter separation）——球结构通过 loss 持续约束 encoder 使表示朝"球友好"方向演化
3. **局部噪声隔离**（把噪声影响限制在球级而非全局）——但实现方式依然依赖标签

你之前的实验恰好证明了：**如果拿掉第 2 点（frozen 表示，球不反馈 encoder），同时不能用第 1、3 点（因为是无监督设置），那粒球退化成纯 kNN 共识——这正是你在 §12.7 观察到的 dcgb ≈ topk。**

---

### Q1：让 encoder 为粒球训练，还有可行性吗？

**有技术可行性，但风险很高，且你已经做了一次弱耦合尝试（§12.9）失败了。**

§12.9 的失败原因是球损失（intra 0.02 / inter 0.2）被 L_GRACE ≈ 6.84 淹没，球质量零改善。但这是"弱耦合"——你保留了 GRACE 损失主导地位、只加了小权重球损失。

如果要真正复刻 CGBC/GBmooer 的思路，需要的是**强耦合**：
- 球损失必须是一等主导损失（像 CGBC 的 `L_clustering + L_SCE`），而不是 GRACE 的附属项
- 这意味着放弃 frozen GRACE 这个你整个项目最稳的基础
- 实质上接近从头设计一个"粒球感知的对比学习框架"

**可行性评估**：
- **理论上可行**：CGBC/GBmooer 证明"先对比再球训练"路线能 work，但它们是 i.i.d. 样本（合约/文本），不是图节点
- **额外障碍**：图节点的同配性（homophily）使得粒球边界和图拓扑高度冗余（你在 §12.1 已经证明），这层额外阻力在 CGBC/GBmooer 中不存在
- **工程量巨大**：需要重新设计 loss 平衡、学习率 schedule、球损失的无标签化版本（因为你不能用 purity/majority-vote）、encoder fine-tuning 的稳定性控制
- **预注册硬止损建议**：如果做，第一步必须是 seed0 冒烟——看强耦合下球质量是否改善（purity 或 AUROC 相比 frozen 有 >1pp 提升），不改善则立即停止

**我的判断**：可以做一次严格的强耦合冒烟实验（1-2 天工作量），但要带硬止损。从先验看不乐观——你面临的额外困难是无标签化球损失（CGBC/GBmooer 的 intra/inter loss 都隐含标签信息通过 purity 或 label distribution 进入），以及图同配性冗余。

---

### Q3：GRACE 不适合构球，换其他对比学习算法会有好效果吗？

**问题的根因不是 GRACE 这个具体算法，而是"frozen 对比表示 + 外挂粒球"这个架构模式。**

你的实验已经非常精确地定位了瓶颈链条：
1. frozen 表示不是"为球而生"的
2. 球的几何信息与 kNN 共识冗余
3. 球结构无法反馈 encoder 来改善自身
4. 转化环节失败（软目标不提交决策，commit-style 转化的是局部一致性而非球结构）

**换成 GraphCL / BGRL / CCA-SSG / GCA 等其他 GCL 算法，这四个瓶颈不会消失**——它们的表示空间同样没有被训练成"球友好"的。换算法只是换了 `z` 的具体值，不改变"球在 frozen 空间上退化为 kNN 共识"这个结构性问题。

除非你做的事情是：**设计一个原生包含粒球约束的对比学习算法**——也就是从 loss 层面就把 intra-ball compactness / inter-ball separation 作为训练目标之一。这本质上就是 Q1 的强耦合路线，只不过从头开始而非改造 GRACE。

---

## 总结建议

| 选项 | 可行性 | 投入 | 预期 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 强耦合冒烟（Q1）| 技术可行，先验不乐观 | 1-2 天 seed0 | 球质量必须 >1pp 改善，否则停 |
| 换 GCL 算法（Q3）| 不解决根因 | 高 | 不推荐单独做 |
| 原生粒球对比学习 | 最大胆，相当于全新方法 | 2-3 周 | 如果有效就是真正的贡献，但风险极高 |
| 诚实主线（方向 2）| 所有证据支持 | 已有数据 | "局部一致性 + commit-style" 为主体 + 负结果机制分析 |

如果导师坚持粒球为核心卖点，我建议：先花 1-2 天做一次严格的强耦合冒烟（无标签化 intra compactness 作为主导损失之一，允许 encoder 微调，带硬止损门）。如果球质量改善 + 下游涨点，再投入展开；如果球质量不改善，则所有"让 encoder 为球服务"的路线都可以关闭，转向方向 2。

你的思考很有深度，让我逐一回答。

---

### Q1：改 claim 让三个关键点都能用？

这个想法的核心是：**从无监督 GRACE 设置转向半监督/有监督噪声标签设置**，这样标签就可以合法使用了。

**这是完全可行的，而且你的实验其实已经在这个设置下了**——你的任务本来就是 noisy-label 鲁棒节点分类，你有（带噪声的）训练标签。关键区别在于：

- 之前你的 claim 是"粒球辅助 GRACE 对比预训练"——所以标签不能进对比阶段
- 如果改成"先用 GRACE 学表示，再用粒球做有监督的噪声标签校正/鲁棒微调"——标签完全合法

改后的 pipeline 变成 CGBC 的图版本：
1. GRACE 无监督预训练（frozen，已有）
2. 在 GRACE 表示上构球 + **用 noisy label 做 majority vote 粗粒度标签校正**
3. **球级 label smoothing**（GBmooer 式）
4. **intra compactness + inter separation 约束微调 encoder**

这样三个关键点全部可以用，且 claim 合理——"图上噪声标签鲁棒分类：先对比再粒球校正"。

**风险**：你的 §12.7 已经证明球 ≈ kNN 共识，所以审稿人会问"为什么不直接用 kNN 做 majority vote"。你需要球提供超越 kNN 的增量——这取决于强耦合训练能否让球结构演化出 kNN 没有的信息。

---

### Q2：针对图节点创造类似的关键算法？

图节点相比 i.i.d. 文本/合约有两个独特资源：

1. **图拓扑**：邻居关系是免费的结构信息，可以替代/增强粒球的"局部"概念
2. **消息传递产生的多阶信息**：GCN 的隐层已经聚合了邻域，kNN 看不到这些

三个关键点的图节点版本可以是：

| 原始关键点 | 图节点适配 |
|---|---|
| 粗粒度标签校正 | 球级 majority vote + **图拓扑一致性加权**（邻居标签一致的球权重更高） |
| 结构约束反馈 encoder | intra compactness + inter separation + **图正则化**（同球节点如果也是图邻居，compactness 权重更大） |
| 局部噪声隔离 | 球级 label smoothing + **边感知隔离**（跨社区边上的噪声标签不扩散到球内） |

这确实是一个差异化贡献的方向——不是照搬 CGBC/GBmooer，而是利用图结构增强粒球的三个机制。

---

### Q3：原生粒球对比学习可行性？

坦率说：**成功概率 30-40%，周期 3-4 周**。

原因：
- 你需要同时设计对比损失和球损失的平衡——§12.9 已经表明这很难（L_GRACE 量级碾压球损失）
- 图节点的同配性让球结构和图拓扑高度冗余
- 没有现成的参考实现，调参空间大

相比之下，Q1 的"改 claim + 有监督粒球微调"路线成功概率更高（60-70%），因为三个关键点都能用，且有 CGBC/GBmooer 作为参考。

---

Perfect! Now let me provide you with a comprehensive summary of the project structure.

## GB Denoising Stage B Compactness Project - Detailed Summary

### **Project Overview**
This is a graph neural network self-supervised learning (SSL) project that trains models on denoised graph data using a "granular ball" (GB) based compactness loss. The system supports multiple training methods (B0-B4) with different ball generation and assignment strategies, and uses negative-free or InfoNCE SSL objectives.

---

### **Key Source Files Analysis**

#### **1. train.py** - Main Training Loop
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/train.py`

**Key Functions:**
- `resolve_device(requested: str) -> torch.device`: Maps device strings ("auto", "cuda", "cpu") to actual device objects
- `_ssl_loss(cfg, p1, z1, p2, z2)`: Computes SSL loss - either InfoNCE or negative-free loss with optional variance regularization
- `_view_rate(value, fallback)`: Fallback handler for per-view augmentation parameters
- `_ball_generator(cfg, embeddings)`: Factory function selecting between "gain_split" and "angular" ball generation algorithms
- `_controlled_assignment(cfg, assignment)`: Controls ball assignment based on method (B3=shuffled, B4=size_matched_random, else original)
- `_build_balls(cfg, embeddings)`: Generates balls and filters by reliability criteria (min/max size, angular distance percentile)
- `_update_ema(target, online, decay)`: Updates target model with exponential moving average of online model parameters

**Main Function:**
- `run_experiment(cfg: StageBConfig) -> Path`: Core training loop that:
  1. Loads graph data and initializes StageBModel
  2. Optionally creates target_model for "negfree_ema" variant
  3. For each epoch:
     - Generates two augmented views of the graph
     - Computes online encoder outputs (h1, z1, p1) and (h2, z2, p2)
     - Computes SSL loss (using target model if negfree_ema variant)
     - Conditionally generates/refreshes balls after warmup_epochs
     - Computes compactness_loss only if balls exist and are reliable
     - Total loss = loss_ssl + lambda_gb * loss_gb
     - Logs metrics (SSL loss, compactness loss, coverage stats)
  4. Post-training: Generates final balls, computes diagnostics, performs linear evaluation
  5. Saves config, metrics, history, and embedding to timestamped run directory

**Post-Training Function:**
- `rebuild_balls_from_run()`: Ablation utility to rebuild balls with different hyperparameters from saved embeddings

---

#### **2. models.py** - Model Architecture
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/models.py`

**Classes:**
- **GCNEncoder**: Graph convolution encoder
  - 2-layer GCN with optional batch normalization
  - Input: (x, edge_index)
  - Output: hidden representation of size hidden_dim
  
- **MLP**: Multi-layer perceptron
  - 2 fully-connected layers with optional batch norm and PReLU activation
  - Used as projector (hidden_dim → proj_dim) and predictor (proj_dim → proj_dim)
  
- **StageBModel**: Complete SSL model
  - Encoder (GCNEncoder) → h (hidden)
  - Projector (MLP) → z (projected)
  - Predictor (MLP) → p (predicted)
  - Variants: "negfree_plain", "negfree_bn" (BN in encoder/projector), "negfree_var", "negfree_ema"

---

#### **3. losses.py** - Loss Functions
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/losses.py`

**Key Functions:**
- `_negative_cosine(p, z)`: Computes negative mean cosine similarity between prediction p and detached target z, both normalized
  - Formula: -(p · z̄).mean() where z̄ is detached and normalized
  
- **negative_free_loss(p1, z2, p2, z1)**: Negative-free SSL loss (symmetric)
  - Loss = 0.5 * [_negative_cosine(p1, z2) + _negative_cosine(p2, z1)]
  - Does NOT use negative pairs (only positive pairs)
  
- **infonce_loss(z1, z2, temperature=0.5)**: Contrastive learning loss
  - Treats batch diagonal as positives, all off-diagonal as negatives
  - Symmetric bidirectional cross-entropy on normalized logits
  
- **variance_loss(z, target_std=1.0)**: Representation collapse prevention
  - Penalizes when dimension-wise std is less than target_std
  - Used optionally in "negfree_var" variant

---

#### **4. balls.py** - Granular Ball Construction
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/balls.py`

**Data Structures:**
- **GranularBall** (diagnostic): immutable ball with indices, center, radius, label histogram, purity, majority_label
- **BallBatch** (training): tensors for assignment, centers, sizes, average_angular_distance (AAD), radius

**Core Ball Generation Algorithms:**

1. **generate_gain_split_balls()**: Recursive binary tree-based splitting
   - Starts with all nodes, recursively splits if:
     - Nodes ≥ 2*min_ball_size and depth < max_depth
     - Split gain (parent_AAD - weighted_child_AAD) ≥ min_split_gain
   - Splits via _gain_split: finds farthest pair via similarity, partitions by angular distance to pivots
   - Output: BallBatch with compactly remapped assignments

2. **generate_angular_balls()**: Hierarchical quality-based splitting
   - Recursively splits oversized balls or low-quality balls (high mean AAD)
   - Split via _angular_split: finds farthest point and second-farthest, partitions by angular distance
   - Falls back to _balanced_split if quality split fails
   - Merges small balls if splitting would create under-min_size children

3. **make_ball_batch()** (overloaded):
   - Variant 1: (embeddings, assignment) → BallBatch
     - Computes normalized centers, sizes, AAD, radius for each ball_id
   - Variant 2: (embeddings, labels, assignments) → list[GranularBall]
     - For diagnostics: includes label histogram and purity

4. **reliable_ball_mask()**: Filters balls by size (min_size ≤ size ≤ max_size) and AAD quality (AAD ≤ percentile threshold)

5. **Assignment Control Functions:**
   - `shuffled_assignments()`: Randomly permutes node assignments (B3)
   - `size_matched_random_assignments()`: Reshuffles while preserving original per-ball size distribution (B4)

**Helper Functions:**
- `angular_distance(a, b)`: Normalized arccos of cosine similarity, clamped to avoid NaN
- `_ball_average_distance()`: Mean angular distance from ball members to normalized center
- `_purity_for_indices()`: Majority class ratio for a set of nodes
- `_gain_split()`, `_angular_split()`, `_balanced_split()`: Various splitting strategies

---

#### **5. config.py** - Configuration Management
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/config.py`

**StageBConfig** (frozen dataclass):

**Model & Training:**
- `hidden_dim`, `proj_dim`: Encoder hidden and projection dimensions (default 256)
- `lr`, `weight_decay`: Adam optimizer params (1e-3, 1e-5)
- `epochs`, `warmup_epochs`: Total epochs and warmup period (1000, 300)

**SSL Objective:**
- `ssl_objective`: "negfree" or "infonce"
- `variant`: "negfree_plain" | "negfree_bn" | "negfree_var" | "negfree_ema"
- `variance_loss_weight`: Coefficient for variance loss (default 1.0)
- `ema_decay`: EMA decay for target model (default 0.99)

**Graph Augmentation:**
- `edge_drop`, `edge_drop_1`, `edge_drop_2`: Edge dropout rates (default 0.2, 0.2, 0.4)
- `feat_mask`, `feat_mask_1`, `feat_mask_2`: Feature masking rates (default 0.2, 0.3, 0.4)
- Per-view parameters (edge_drop_1/2, feat_mask_1/2) override global defaults

**Ball Configuration:**
- `ball_space`: "H" (hidden) or "Z" (projected) space for ball construction (default "H")
- `ball_algorithm`: "gain_split" or "angular"
- `ball_refresh_interval`: Refresh frequency (0 = only at warmup, >0 = every N epochs)
- `lambda_gb`: Compactness loss weight (default 0.005)

**Gain-Split Algorithm:**
- `gain_split_min_ball_size`: Minimum nodes per ball (default 8)
- `gain_split_max_depth`: Maximum tree depth (default 12)
- `gain_split_min_gain`: Minimum split gain threshold (default 0.001)

**Ball Reliability Filtering:**
- `reliable_ball_min_size`, `reliable_ball_max_size`: Size constraints (3, 256)
- `reliable_ball_ad_percentile`: AAD quality threshold percentile (default 50)

**Method Selection:**
- `method`: "B0" (no balls) | "B1" (original balls) | "B2" (refresh) | "B3" (shuffled) | "B4" (size_matched_random)
- `assignment_control`: Controls B3/B4 behavior

**Dataset & Experiment:**
- `dataset`: "Cora", "CiteSeer", "PubMed", or "Synthetic"
- `seed`: Random seed
- `device`: "auto", "cuda", "cpu"
- `experiment_group`: Label for grouping results
- `results_dir`: Output directory

**Synthetic Dataset Parameters:**
- `num_nodes`, `num_classes`, `feature_dim`: Graph structure
- `knn_k`: K-nearest neighbor edges
- `label_noise`: Train set label noise fraction
- `train_ratio`, `val_ratio`, `test_ratio`: Split proportions

**Validation:** `__post_init__()` enforces all constraints (ranges, enums, sums, dependencies)

**load_config()**: Loads YAML and applies overrides, returning StageBConfig instance

---

#### **6. compactness.py** - Compactness Loss
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/compactness.py`

**Function: compactness_loss(z, assignment, centers, reliable_balls)**
- **Input:**
  - z: Node embeddings [N, D]
  - assignment: Ball IDs per node [N]
  - centers: Ball centers [B, D] (normalized)
  - reliable_balls: Boolean mask [B] indicating which balls to use
  
- **Logic:**
  1. Filter to reliable ball members: node_reliable = reliable_balls[assignment]
  2. If no reliable nodes: return zero loss + stats
  3. Compute angular distance from selected nodes to their ball centers
  4. Loss = mean angular distance
  
- **Output:** (loss tensor, stats dict) with:
  - covered_nodes: Count of nodes in reliable balls
  - covered_ratio: Fraction of all nodes in reliable balls
  - mean_distance: Mean angular distance (before detach)

**Purpose:** Pulls reliable nodes toward their ball centers in angular space, encouraging compactness

---

#### **7. augment.py** - Graph Augmentation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/augment.py`

**Functions:**
- **drop_edges(edge_index, drop_prob, seed)**: Randomly removes edges with probability drop_prob
  - Returns edge_index with shape [2, E'] where E' < E
  
- **mask_features(x, mask_prob, seed)**: Zeros out features with probability mask_prob per element
  - Returns modified feature tensor same shape as input
  
- **make_two_views(x, edge_index, edge_drop_1, edge_drop_2, feat_mask_1, feat_mask_2, seed)**:
  - Creates two augmented views for contrastive learning
  - Seeds offset by ±1 for independence
  - Returns (x1, e1, x2, e2) tuple

---

#### **8. cli.py** - Command-Line Interface
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/cli.py`

**Subcommands:**
1. `run --config <path>` [options]: Executes training
   - Options: `--dataset`, `--method`, `--ssl-objective`, `--variant`, `--device`, `--seed`, `--epochs`, `--warmup-epochs`, `--ball-algorithm`, `--gain-split-*`, `--results-dir`, `--edge-drop-*`, `--feat-mask-*`
   
2. `summarize --results <path>`: Aggregates metrics across runs
   - Outputs: `stage_b_summary.csv` (all metrics), `stage_b_grouped_summary.csv` (grouped by experiment), `stage_b_paired_deltas.csv` (B0 baseline comparison)
   
3. `rebuild-balls --run-dir <path> --min-ball-size <int> --max-depth <int> --min-split-gain <float>`: Ablation on saved embeddings

---

#### **9. report.py** - Results Aggregation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/report.py`

**Function: summarize_results(results_dir) -> Path**
- **Logic:**
  1. Collects all `metrics.json` files from run directories
  2. Aggregates into `stage_b_summary.csv` (all runs, all metrics)
  3. Groups by [experiment_group, dataset, seed, ssl_objective, variant] into `stage_b_grouped_summary.csv`
  4. Computes deltas: for each dataset/seed, compares all methods to B0 baseline
  5. Outputs: `stage_b_paired_deltas.csv`
  
- **Tracked metrics:** linear_eval_acc, mean_radius, mean_average_angular_distance, effective_rank (deltas)
- **Summary metrics:** mean_radius, AAD, label_purity, linear_eval_acc, effective_rank, feature_std

---

#### **10. data.py** - Data Loading
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/data.py`

**Functions:**
- **load_graph(name, seed)**: Loads Planetoid (Cora, CiteSeer, PubMed) or Synthetic graph

- **make_synthetic_graph(config)**: Creates synthetic blob-based graph with:
  - Features: make_blobs (config.num_nodes, config.feature_dim, config.num_classes)
  - Edges: KNN graph with k=config.knn_k
  - Labels: Noisy train labels (noise_rate = config.label_noise)
  - Masks: Stratified train/val/test splits
  
- **_apply_train_label_noise()**: Corrupts train set labels, returns (noisy_labels, noise_mask)
- **_stratified_masks()**: Train/val/test stratified split preserving class proportions
- **_knn_edge_index()**: Constructs KNN adjacency from features

---

#### **11. eval.py** - Linear Evaluation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/eval.py`

**Function: linear_eval(embeddings, labels, train_mask, val_mask, test_mask, seed) -> float**
- Trains logistic regression on train split embeddings
- Evaluates accuracy on test split
- Returns test accuracy (0-1)

---

#### **12. diagnostics.py** - Representation Analysis
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/diagnostics.py`

**Functions:**
- **ball_diagnostics(balls, labels)**: Returns ball geometry metrics
  - num_balls, mean_ball_size, max_ball_size, singleton_ratio
  - mean_radius, mean_average_angular_distance
  - label_purity_diagnostic (if labels provided)
  
- **representation_diagnostics(z)**: Returns embedding quality metrics
  - effective_rank: Shannon entropy of singular value distribution
  - feature_std_mean: Mean std across dimensions
  - mean_pairwise_cosine: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity
  - embedding_uniformity: Log-probability of uniform distribution

---

#### **13. utils.py** - Utilities
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/utils.py`

**Functions:**
- **set_seed(seed)**: Sets random, numpy, torch seeds for reproducibility
- **ensure_dir(path)**: Creates directory and parents
- **write_json()**, **read_json()**: File I/O with UTF-8

---

### **Configuration File**
**Path:** `configs/stage_b.yaml`

Default settings for Synthetic dataset:
- Method: B0 (no balls)
- SSL: negative-free, plain variant
- Gain-split: min_ball_size=8, max_depth=12, min_split_gain=0.001
- Augmentation: asymmetric (edge_drop: 0.2→0.4, feat_mask: 0.3→0.4)
- Lambda GB: 0.005 (compactness weight)

---

### **Data Flow Summary**

```
load_graph(dataset) 
  → Data (x, edge_index, y, masks)
       ↓
    StageBModel (GCN Encoder + MLP Projector/Predictor)
       ↓
Training Loop (epochs):
  ├─ Augment: make_two_views → (x1, e1, x2, e2)
  ├─ Forward: (h1, z1, p1), (h2, z2, p2)
  ├─ Loss SSL: negative_free_loss or infonce_loss
  ├─ Ball Generation (after warmup, conditionally):
  │  ├─ generate_gain_split_balls or generate_angular_balls
  │  ├─ reliable_ball_mask filtering
  │  └─ Assignment control (shuffled/size_matched_random)
  ├─ Loss GB: compactness_loss (pulls to centers)
  └─ Optimize: loss = loss_SSL + lambda_gb * loss_GB
       ↓
Post-Training:
  ├─ Final balls: ball_diagnostics
  ├─ Representation: representation_diagnostics
  ├─ Linear eval: linear_eval (logistic regression)
  └─ Save: config.json, metrics.json, history.json, embedding.pt
       ↓
    Results Aggregation: summarize_results → CSVs with grouped stats & deltas vs B0
```

---

### **Key Concepts**

1. **Methods (B0-B4):**
   - **B0**: SSL only, no balls
   - **B1**: Static balls (one-time construction)
   - **B2**: Refreshed balls (every N epochs)
   - **B3**: Shuffled assignments (control ablation)
   - **B4**: Size-matched random assignments (control ablation)

2. **Variants:**
   - **negfree_plain**: Bare negative-free loss
   - **negfree_bn**: + batch norm in encoder/projector
   - **negfree_var**: + variance loss regularization
   - **negfree_ema**: + target model with EMA updates

3. **Ball Spaces:**
   - **H**: Construct balls in encoder hidden space
   - **Z**: Construct balls in normalized projection space

4. **Compactness Loss**: Pulls nodes toward detached ball centers, encouraging spatial clustering while preserving representation quality

---

This is a complete self-supervised learning framework for graph denoising with granular ball-based compactness regularization, supporting multiple ball construction algorithms, control ablations, and comprehensive evaluation metrics.

   - Split via _angular_split: finds farthest point and second-farthest, partitions by angular distance
   - Falls back to _balanced_split if quality split fails
   - Merges small balls if splitting would create under-min_size children

3. **make_ball_batch()** (overloaded):
   - Variant 1: (embeddings, assignment) → BallBatch
     - Computes normalized centers, sizes, AAD, radius for each ball_id
   - Variant 2: (embeddings, labels, assignments) → list[GranularBall]
     - For diagnostics: includes label histogram and purity

4. **reliable_ball_mask()**: Filters balls by size (min_size ≤ size ≤ max_size) and AAD quality (AAD ≤ percentile threshold)

5. **Assignment Control Functions:**
   - `shuffled_assignments()`: Randomly permutes node assignments (B3)
   - `size_matched_random_assignments()`: Reshuffles while preserving original per-ball size distribution (B4)

**Helper Functions:**
- `angular_distance(a, b)`: Normalized arccos of cosine similarity, clamped to avoid NaN
- `_ball_average_distance()`: Mean angular distance from ball members to normalized center
- `_purity_for_indices()`: Majority class ratio for a set of nodes
- `_gain_split()`, `_angular_split()`, `_balanced_split()`: Various splitting strategies

---

#### **5. config.py** - Configuration Management
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/config.py`

**StageBConfig** (frozen dataclass):

**Model & Training:**
- `hidden_dim`, `proj_dim`: Encoder hidden and projection dimensions (default 256)
- `lr`, `weight_decay`: Adam optimizer params (1e-3, 1e-5)
- `epochs`, `warmup_epochs`: Total epochs and warmup period (1000, 300)

**SSL Objective:**
- `ssl_objective`: "negfree" or "infonce"
- `variant`: "negfree_plain" | "negfree_bn" | "negfree_var" | "negfree_ema"
- `variance_loss_weight`: Coefficient for variance loss (default 1.0)
- `ema_decay`: EMA decay for target model (default 0.99)

**Graph Augmentation:**
- `edge_drop`, `edge_drop_1`, `edge_drop_2`: Edge dropout rates (default 0.2, 0.2, 0.4)
- `feat_mask`, `feat_mask_1`, `feat_mask_2`: Feature masking rates (default 0.2, 0.3, 0.4)
- Per-view parameters (edge_drop_1/2, feat_mask_1/2) override global defaults

**Ball Configuration:**
- `ball_space`: "H" (hidden) or "Z" (projected) space for ball construction (default "H")
- `ball_algorithm`: "gain_split" or "angular"
- `ball_refresh_interval`: Refresh frequency (0 = only at warmup, >0 = every N epochs)
- `lambda_gb`: Compactness loss weight (default 0.005)

**Gain-Split Algorithm:**
- `gain_split_min_ball_size`: Minimum nodes per ball (default 8)
- `gain_split_max_depth`: Maximum tree depth (default 12)
- `gain_split_min_gain`: Minimum split gain threshold (default 0.001)

**Ball Reliability Filtering:**
- `reliable_ball_min_size`, `reliable_ball_max_size`: Size constraints (3, 256)
- `reliable_ball_ad_percentile`: AAD quality threshold percentile (default 50)

**Method Selection:**
- `method`: "B0" (no balls) | "B1" (original balls) | "B2" (refresh) | "B3" (shuffled) | "B4" (size_matched_random)
- `assignment_control`: Controls B3/B4 behavior

**Dataset & Experiment:**
- `dataset`: "Cora", "CiteSeer", "PubMed", or "Synthetic"
- `seed`: Random seed
- `device`: "auto", "cuda", "cpu"
- `experiment_group`: Label for grouping results
- `results_dir`: Output directory

**Synthetic Dataset Parameters:**
- `num_nodes`, `num_classes`, `feature_dim`: Graph structure
- `knn_k`: K-nearest neighbor edges
- `label_noise`: Train set label noise fraction
- `train_ratio`, `val_ratio`, `test_ratio`: Split proportions

**Validation:** `__post_init__()` enforces all constraints (ranges, enums, sums, dependencies)

**load_config()**: Loads YAML and applies overrides, returning StageBConfig instance

---

#### **6. compactness.py** - Compactness Loss
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/compactness.py`

**Function: compactness_loss(z, assignment, centers, reliable_balls)**
- **Input:**
  - z: Node embeddings [N, D]
  - assignment: Ball IDs per node [N]
  - centers: Ball centers [B, D] (normalized)
  - reliable_balls: Boolean mask [B] indicating which balls to use
  
- **Logic:**
  1. Filter to reliable ball members: node_reliable = reliable_balls[assignment]
  2. If no reliable nodes: return zero loss + stats
  3. Compute angular distance from selected nodes to their ball centers
  4. Loss = mean angular distance
  
- **Output:** (loss tensor, stats dict) with:
  - covered_nodes: Count of nodes in reliable balls
  - covered_ratio: Fraction of all nodes in reliable balls
  - mean_distance: Mean angular distance (before detach)

**Purpose:** Pulls reliable nodes toward their ball centers in angular space, encouraging compactness

---

#### **7. augment.py** - Graph Augmentation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/augment.py`

**Functions:**
- **drop_edges(edge_index, drop_prob, seed)**: Randomly removes edges with probability drop_prob
  - Returns edge_index with shape [2, E'] where E' < E
  
- **mask_features(x, mask_prob, seed)**: Zeros out features with probability mask_prob per element
  - Returns modified feature tensor same shape as input
  
- **make_two_views(x, edge_index, edge_drop_1, edge_drop_2, feat_mask_1, feat_mask_2, seed)**:
  - Creates two augmented views for contrastive learning
  - Seeds offset by ±1 for independence
  - Returns (x1, e1, x2, e2) tuple

---

#### **8. cli.py** - Command-Line Interface
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/cli.py`

**Subcommands:**
1. `run --config <path>` [options]: Executes training
   - Options: `--dataset`, `--method`, `--ssl-objective`, `--variant`, `--device`, `--seed`, `--epochs`, `--warmup-epochs`, `--ball-algorithm`, `--gain-split-*`, `--results-dir`, `--edge-drop-*`, `--feat-mask-*`
   
2. `summarize --results <path>`: Aggregates metrics across runs
   - Outputs: `stage_b_summary.csv` (all metrics), `stage_b_grouped_summary.csv` (grouped by experiment), `stage_b_paired_deltas.csv` (B0 baseline comparison)
   
3. `rebuild-balls --run-dir <path> --min-ball-size <int> --max-depth <int> --min-split-gain <float>`: Ablation on saved embeddings

---

#### **9. report.py** - Results Aggregation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/report.py`

**Function: summarize_results(results_dir) -> Path**
- **Logic:**
  1. Collects all `metrics.json` files from run directories
  2. Aggregates into `stage_b_summary.csv` (all runs, all metrics)
  3. Groups by [experiment_group, dataset, seed, ssl_objective, variant] into `stage_b_grouped_summary.csv`
  4. Computes deltas: for each dataset/seed, compares all methods to B0 baseline
  5. Outputs: `stage_b_paired_deltas.csv`
  
- **Tracked metrics:** linear_eval_acc, mean_radius, mean_average_angular_distance, effective_rank (deltas)
- **Summary metrics:** mean_radius, AAD, label_purity, linear_eval_acc, effective_rank, feature_std

---

#### **10. data.py** - Data Loading
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/data.py`

**Functions:**
- **load_graph(name, seed)**: Loads Planetoid (Cora, CiteSeer, PubMed) or Synthetic graph

- **make_synthetic_graph(config)**: Creates synthetic blob-based graph with:
  - Features: make_blobs (config.num_nodes, config.feature_dim, config.num_classes)
  - Edges: KNN graph with k=config.knn_k
  - Labels: Noisy train labels (noise_rate = config.label_noise)
  - Masks: Stratified train/val/test splits
  
- **_apply_train_label_noise()**: Corrupts train set labels, returns (noisy_labels, noise_mask)
- **_stratified_masks()**: Train/val/test stratified split preserving class proportions
- **_knn_edge_index()**: Constructs KNN adjacency from features

---

#### **11. eval.py** - Linear Evaluation
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/eval.py`

**Function: linear_eval(embeddings, labels, train_mask, val_mask, test_mask, seed) -> float**
- Trains logistic regression on train split embeddings
- Evaluates accuracy on test split
- Returns test accuracy (0-1)

---

#### **12. diagnostics.py** - Representation Analysis
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/diagnostics.py`

**Functions:**
- **ball_diagnostics(balls, labels)**: Returns ball geometry metrics
  - num_balls, mean_ball_size, max_ball_size, singleton_ratio
  - mean_radius, mean_average_angular_distance
  - label_purity_diagnostic (if labels provided)
  
- **representation_diagnostics(z)**: Returns embedding quality metrics
  - effective_rank: Shannon entropy of singular value distribution
  - feature_std_mean: Mean std across dimensions
  - mean_pairwise_cosine: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity
  - embedding_uniformity: Log-probability of uniform distribution

---

#### **13. utils.py** - Utilities
**Path:** `src/gb_stage_b/utils.py`

**Functions:**
- **set_seed(seed)**: Sets random, numpy, torch seeds for reproducibility
- **ensure_dir(path)**: Creates directory and parents
- **write_json()**, **read_json()**: File I/O with UTF-8

---

### **Configuration File**
**Path:** `configs/stage_b.yaml`

Default settings for Synthetic dataset:
- Method: B0 (no balls)
- SSL: negative-free, plain variant
- Gain-split: min_ball_size=8, max_depth=12, min_split_gain=0.001
- Augmentation: asymmetric (edge_drop: 0.2→0.4, feat_mask: 0.3→0.4)
- Lambda GB: 0.005 (compactness weight)

---

### **Data Flow Summary**

```
load_graph(dataset) 
  → Data (x, edge_index, y, masks)
       ↓
    StageBModel (GCN Encoder + MLP Projector/Predictor)
       ↓
Training Loop (epochs):
  ├─ Augment: make_two_views → (x1, e1, x2, e2)
  ├─ Forward: (h1, z1, p1), (h2, z2, p2)
  ├─ Loss SSL: negative_free_loss or infonce_loss
  ├─ Ball Generation (after warmup, conditionally):
  │  ├─ generate_gain_split_balls or generate_angular_balls
  │  ├─ reliable_ball_mask filtering
  │  └─ Assignment control (shuffled/size_matched_random)
  ├─ Loss GB: compactness_loss (pulls to centers)
  └─ Optimize: loss = loss_SSL + lambda_gb * loss_GB
       ↓
Post-Training:
  ├─ Final balls: ball_diagnostics
  ├─ Representation: representation_diagnostics
  ├─ Linear eval: linear_eval (logistic regression)
  └─ Save: config.json, metrics.json, history.json, embedding.pt
       ↓
    Results Aggregation: summarize_results → CSVs with grouped stats & deltas vs B0
```

---

### **Key Concepts**

1. **Methods (B0-B4):**
   - **B0**: SSL only, no balls
   - **B1**: Static balls (one-time construction)
   - **B2**: Refreshed balls (every N epochs)
   - **B3**: Shuffled assignments (control ablation)
   - **B4**: Size-matched random assignments (control ablation)

2. **Variants:**
   - **negfree_plain**: Bare negative-free loss
   - **negfree_bn**: + batch norm in encoder/projector
   - **negfree_var**: + variance loss regularization
   - **negfree_ema**: + target model with EMA updates

3. **Ball Spaces:**
   - **H**: Construct balls in encoder hidden space
   - **Z**: Construct balls in normalized projection space

4. **Compactness Loss**: Pulls nodes toward detached ball centers, encouraging spatial clustering while preserving representation quality

---

This is a complete self-supervised learning framework for graph denoising with granular ball-based compactness regularization, supporting multiple ball construction algorithms, control ablations, and comprehensive evaluation metrics.

    reliable_ball_mask,
    shuffled_assignments,
    size_matched_random_assignments,
)
from gb_stage_b.compactness import compactness_loss
from gb_stage_b.config import StageBConfig
from gb_stage_b.data import load_graph
from gb_stage_b.diagnostics import ball_diagnostics, representation_diagnostics
from gb_stage_b.eval import linear_eval
from gb_stage_b.losses import infonce_loss, negative_free_loss, variance_loss
from gb_stage_b.models import StageBModel
from gb_stage_b.utils import ensure_dir, read_json, set_seed, write_json


def resolve_device(requested: str) -> torch.device:
    if requested == "cpu":
        return torch.device("cpu")
    if requested == "cuda":
        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
            raise RuntimeError("CUDA was requested but torch.cuda.is_available() is false")
        return torch.device("cuda")
    if requested == "auto":
        return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    raise ValueError("device must be auto, cuda, or cpu")


def _ssl_loss(cfg: StageBConfig, p1: torch.Tensor, z1: torch.Tensor, p2: torch.Tensor, z2: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if cfg.ssl_objective == "infonce":
        return infonce_loss(z1, z2)
    loss = negative_free_loss(p1, z2, p2, z1)
    if cfg.variant == "negfree_var":
        loss = loss + cfg.variance_loss_weight * 0.5 * (variance_loss(z1) + variance_loss(z2))
    return loss


def _view_rate(value: float | None, fallback: float) -> float:
    return fallback if value is None else value


def _ball_generator(cfg: StageBConfig, embeddings: torch.Tensor):
    if cfg.ball_algorithm == "gain_split":
        return generate_gain_split_balls(
            embeddings,
            min_ball_size=cfg.gain_split_min_ball_size,
            max_depth=cfg.gain_split_max_depth,
            min_split_gain=cfg.gain_split_min_gain,
        )
    return generate_angular_balls(
        embeddings,
        min_size=cfg.reliable_ball_min_size,
        max_size=cfg.reliable_ball_max_size,
        quality_threshold=0.35,
    )


def _controlled_assignment(cfg: StageBConfig, assignment: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if cfg.method == "B3" or cfg.assignment_control == "shuffled":
        return shuffled_assignments(assignment, seed=cfg.seed)
    if cfg.method == "B4" or cfg.assignment_control == "size_matched_random":
        return size_matched_random_assignments(assignment, seed=cfg.seed)
    return assignment


def _build_balls(cfg: StageBConfig, embeddings: torch.Tensor):
    balls = _ball_generator(cfg, embeddings.detach())
    assignment = _controlled_assignment(cfg, balls.assignment)
    if not torch.equal(assignment, balls.assignment):
        balls = make_ball_batch(embeddings.detach(), assignment)
    reliable = reliable_ball_mask(
        balls,
        min_size=cfg.reliable_ball_min_size,
        max_size=cfg.reliable_ball_max_size,
        ad_percentile=cfg.reliable_ball_ad_percentile,
    )
    return balls, reliable


def _update_ema(target: StageBModel, online: StageBModel, decay: float) -> None:
    with torch.no_grad():
        for target_param, online_param in zip(target.parameters(), online.parameters()):
            target_param.mul_(decay).add_(online_param.detach(), alpha=1.0 - decay)
        for target_buffer, online_buffer in zip(target.buffers(), online.buffers()):
            target_buffer.copy_(online_buffer)


def run_experiment(cfg: StageBConfig) -> Path:
    set_seed(cfg.seed)
    device = resolve_device(cfg.device)
    data = load_graph(cfg.dataset, seed=cfg.seed).to(device)
    model = StageBModel(data.x.size(1), cfg.hidden_dim, cfg.proj_dim, variant=cfg.variant).to(device)
    target_model = None
    if cfg.variant == "negfree_ema":
        target_model = copy.deepcopy(model).to(device)
        target_model.eval()
        for param in target_model.parameters():
            param.requires_grad_(False)
    opt = Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg.lr, weight_decay=cfg.weight_decay)
    balls = None
    reliable = None
    history = []

    for epoch in range(cfg.epochs):
        model.train()
        x1, e1, x2, e2 = make_two_views(
            data.x,
            data.edge_index,
            edge_drop_1=_view_rate(cfg.edge_drop_1, cfg.edge_drop),
            edge_drop_2=_view_rate(cfg.edge_drop_2, cfg.edge_drop),
            feat_mask_1=_view_rate(cfg.feat_mask_1, cfg.feat_mask),
            feat_mask_2=_view_rate(cfg.feat_mask_2, cfg.feat_mask),
            seed=cfg.seed + epoch * 2,
        )
        h1, z1, p1 = model(x1, e1)
        _, z2_online, p2 = model(x2, e2)
        if target_model is not None and cfg.ssl_objective == "negfree":
            target_model.eval()
            with torch.no_grad():
                _, z1_target, _ = target_model(x1, e1)
                _, z2_target, _ = target_model(x2, e2)
            loss_ssl = negative_free_loss(p1, z2_target, p2, z1_target)
        else:
            loss_ssl = _ssl_loss(cfg, p1, z1, p2, z2_online)
        loss_gb = loss_ssl.new_tensor(0.0)
        gb_stats = {"covered_nodes": 0.0, "covered_ratio": 0.0, "mean_distance": 0.0}

        should_use_gb = cfg.method in {"B1", "B2", "B3", "B4"} and epoch >= cfg.warmup_epochs
        should_refresh = balls is None or (
            cfg.method == "B2" and cfg.ball_refresh_interval > 0 and epoch % cfg.ball_refresh_interval == 0
        )
        if should_use_gb and should_refresh:
            with torch.no_grad():
                h_full, z_full, _ = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
                space = h_full if cfg.ball_space == "H" else z_full
                balls, reliable = _build_balls(cfg, F.normalize(space, dim=-1, eps=1e-8))
        if should_use_gb and balls is not None and reliable is not None:
            current = h1 if cfg.ball_space == "H" else z1
            loss_gb, gb_stats = compactness_loss(current, balls.assignment, balls.centers, reliable)

        loss = loss_ssl + cfg.lambda_gb * loss_gb
        opt.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()
        if target_model is not None:
            _update_ema(target_model, model, cfg.ema_decay)
        history.append(
            {
                "epoch": epoch,
                "loss_ssl": float(loss_ssl.detach().item()),
                "loss_compact": float(loss_gb.detach().item()),
                "loss_compact_weighted": float((cfg.lambda_gb * loss_gb).detach().item()),
                **gb_stats,
            }
        )

    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        h, z, _ = model(data.x, data.edge_index)
        final_space = F.normalize(h if cfg.ball_space == "H" else z, dim=-1, eps=1e-8)
        final_balls = _ball_generator(cfg, final_space)

    metrics = {}
    metrics.update(ball_diagnostics(final_balls, labels=data.y))
    metrics.update(representation_diagnostics(final_space))
    metrics["linear_eval_acc"] = linear_eval(final_space, data.y, data.train_mask, data.val_mask, data.test_mask, seed=cfg.seed)
    compact_values = [float(row["loss_compact"]) for row in history]
    covered_values = [float(row["covered_nodes"]) for row in history]
    metrics["compact_nonzero_epochs"] = float(sum(1 for value in compact_values if abs(value) > 1e-12))
    metrics["covered_nodes_max"] = float(max(covered_values) if covered_values else 0.0)
    metrics["covered_nodes_last"] = float(covered_values[-1] if covered_values else 0.0)
    metrics["dataset"] = cfg.dataset
    metrics["method"] = cfg.method
    metrics["seed"] = cfg.seed
    metrics["ssl_objective"] = cfg.ssl_objective
    metrics["variant"] = cfg.variant
    metrics["experiment_group"] = cfg.experiment_group
    metrics["ball_algorithm"] = cfg.ball_algorithm
    metrics["device"] = str(device)
    metrics["gain_split_min_ball_size"] = float(cfg.gain_split_min_ball_size)
    metrics["gain_split_max_depth"] = float(cfg.gain_split_max_depth)
    metrics["gain_split_min_gain"] = float(cfg.gain_split_min_gain)

    run_id = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
    out_dir = ensure_dir(Path(cfg.results_dir) / cfg.dataset / cfg.method / f"seed_{cfg.seed}" / run_id)
    write_json(out_dir / "config.json", asdict(cfg))
    write_json(out_dir / "metrics.json", metrics)
    write_json(out_dir / "history.json", {"history": history})
    torch.save(final_space.detach().cpu(), out_dir / "embedding.pt")
    return out_dir


def rebuild_balls_from_run(run_dir: str | Path, min_ball_size: int, max_depth: int, min_split_gain: float) -> Path:
    run_dir = Path(run_dir)
    cfg = StageBConfig(**read_json(run_dir / "config.json"))
    embedding = torch.load(run_dir / "embedding.pt", map_location="cpu")
    data = load_graph(cfg.dataset, seed=cfg.seed)
    balls = generate_gain_split_balls(
        embedding,
        min_ball_size=min_ball_size,
        max_depth=max_depth,
        min_split_gain=min_split_gain,
    )
    metrics = {}
    metrics.update(ball_diagnostics(balls, labels=data.y))
    metrics.update(representation_diagnostics(embedding))
    metrics["linear_eval_acc"] = linear_eval(embedding, data.y, data.train_mask, data.val_mask, data.test_mask, seed=cfg.seed)
    metrics["dataset"] = cfg.dataset
    metrics["method"] = cfg.method
    metrics["seed"] = cfg.seed
    metrics["ssl_objective"] = cfg.ssl_objective
    metrics["variant"] = cfg.variant
    metrics["experiment_group"] = cfg.experiment_group
    metrics["ball_algorithm"] = "gain_split"
    metrics["gain_split_min_ball_size"] = float(min_ball_size)
    metrics["gain_split_max_depth"] = float(max_depth)
    metrics["gain_split_min_gain"] = float(min_split_gain)
    token = str(min_split_gain).replace(".", "p")
    out = run_dir / "ball_ablation" / f"gain_split_mbs{min_ball_size}_depth{max_depth}_gain{token}.json"
    write_json(out, metrics)
    return out

from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from gb_stage_b.balls import angular_distance


def compactness_loss(
    z: torch.Tensor,
    assignment: torch.Tensor,
    centers: torch.Tensor,
    reliable_balls: torch.Tensor,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, float]]:
    """Pull nodes toward detached reliable ball centers in angular space."""
    if z.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("z must have shape [N, D]")
    if centers.ndim != 2 or centers.size(1) != z.size(1):
        raise ValueError("centers must have shape [B, D] matching z")
    if assignment.ndim != 1 or assignment.numel() != z.size(0):
        raise ValueError("assignment must be a 1D tensor matching z rows")
    if reliable_balls.ndim != 1 or reliable_balls.numel() != centers.size(0):
        raise ValueError("reliable_balls must be a 1D tensor matching centers")
    if assignment.numel() and (assignment.min().item() < 0 or assignment.max().item() >= centers.size(0)):
        raise ValueError("assignment contains ball ids outside centers")

    assignment = assignment.to(device=z.device, dtype=torch.long)
    reliable_balls = reliable_balls.to(device=z.device, dtype=torch.bool)
    z_norm = F.normalize(z, dim=-1, eps=1e-8)
    centers_norm = F.normalize(centers.detach().to(device=z.device, dtype=z.dtype), dim=-1, eps=1e-8)
    node_reliable = reliable_balls[assignment]

    covered_nodes = int(node_reliable.sum().item())
    if covered_nodes == 0:
        return z_norm.sum() * 0.0, {
            "covered_nodes": 0.0,
            "covered_ratio": 0.0,
            "mean_distance": 0.0,
        }

    selected_z = z_norm[node_reliable]
    selected_centers = centers_norm[assignment[node_reliable]]
    dist = angular_distance(selected_z, selected_centers)
    loss = dist.mean()
    return loss, {
        "covered_nodes": float(covered_nodes),
        "covered_ratio": float(node_reliable.float().mean().item()),
        "mean_distance": float(dist.detach().mean().item()),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
from torch_geometric.data import Data
from torch_geometric.datasets import Planetoid

from gb_stage_b.config import StageBConfig


def _mask_from_indices(num_nodes: int, indices: np.ndarray) -> torch.Tensor:
    mask = torch.zeros(num_nodes, dtype=torch.bool)
    mask[torch.as_tensor(indices, dtype=torch.long)] = True
    return mask


def _stratified_masks(
    labels: np.ndarray,
    config: StageBConfig,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    class_counts = np.bincount(labels, minlength=config.num_classes)
    train_size = int(config.num_nodes * config.train_ratio)
    val_size = int(config.num_nodes * config.val_ratio)
    test_size = config.num_nodes - train_size - val_size
    split_sizes = {"train": train_size, "val": val_size, "test": test_size}
    if any(size < config.num_classes for size in split_sizes.values()):
        raise ValueError(
            "stratified split requires each split to have at least one node per class; "
            f"got {split_sizes} for {config.num_classes} classes"
        )
    if class_counts.min() < 3:
        raise ValueError("stratified split requires at least 3 nodes per class")

    indices = np.arange(labels.shape[0])
    try:
        train_idx, temp_idx, _, temp_labels = train_test_split(
            indices,
            labels,
            train_size=train_size,
            stratify=labels,
            random_state=config.seed,
        )
        val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
            temp_idx,
            train_size=val_size,
            stratify=temp_labels,
            random_state=config.seed,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"stratified split failed for synthetic graph: {exc}") from exc
    return (
        _mask_from_indices(config.num_nodes, train_idx),
        _mask_from_indices(config.num_nodes, val_idx),
        _mask_from_indices(config.num_nodes, test_idx),
    )


def _knn_edge_index(features: np.ndarray, k: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=min(features.shape[0], k + 2))
    neighbors.fit(features)
    _, indices = neighbors.kneighbors(features)
    edges: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for node, row in enumerate(indices):
        dst = [int(neighbor) for neighbor in row if int(neighbor) != node][:k]
        if len(dst) != k:
            raise ValueError("knn_k must leave enough non-self neighbors for every node")
        edges.extend((node, neighbor) for neighbor in dst)
    edges = np.asarray(edges, dtype=np.int64).T
    return torch.as_tensor(edges, dtype=torch.long).contiguous()


def _apply_train_label_noise(
    labels: np.ndarray,
    train_mask: torch.Tensor,
    label_noise: float,
    num_classes: int,
    seed: int,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    noisy = labels.copy()
    train_indices = torch.nonzero(train_mask, as_tuple=False).flatten().cpu().numpy()
    num_noisy = int(round(train_indices.shape[0] * label_noise))
    noise_mask = torch.zeros(labels.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool)
    if num_noisy == 0:
        return torch.as_tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.long), noise_mask

    noisy_indices = rng.choice(train_indices, size=num_noisy, replace=False)
    for idx in noisy_indices:
        current = int(labels[idx])
        choices = [cls for cls in range(num_classes) if cls != current]
        noisy[idx] = int(rng.choice(choices))
    noise_mask[torch.as_tensor(noisy_indices, dtype=torch.long)] = True
    return torch.as_tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.long), noise_mask


def make_synthetic_graph(config: StageBConfig) -> Data:
    features, labels = make_blobs(
        n_samples=config.num_nodes,
        n_features=config.feature_dim,
        centers=config.num_classes,
        cluster_std=1.0,
        random_state=config.seed,
    )
    labels = labels.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    train_mask, val_mask, test_mask = _stratified_masks(labels, config)
    y_noisy, noise_mask = _apply_train_label_noise(
        labels=labels,
        train_mask=train_mask,
        label_noise=config.label_noise,
        num_classes=config.num_classes,
        seed=config.seed,
    )
    y_true = torch.as_tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
    return Data(
        x=torch.as_tensor(features, dtype=torch.float32),
        edge_index=_knn_edge_index(features, config.knn_k),
        y=y_noisy,
        y_true=y_true,
        y_noisy=y_noisy,
        train_mask=train_mask,
        val_mask=val_mask,
        test_mask=test_mask,
        noise_mask=noise_mask,
    )


def synthetic_graph(seed: int = 0, config: StageBConfig | None = None) -> Data:
    if config is None:
        config = StageBConfig(dataset="Synthetic", seed=seed)
    elif config.seed != seed:
        config = StageBConfig(**{**config.__dict__, "seed": seed})
    return make_synthetic_graph(config)


def load_graph(name: str, seed: int = 0, root: str | Path = "data") -> Data:
    if name == "Synthetic":
        return synthetic_graph(seed=seed)
    if name not in {"Cora", "CiteSeer", "PubMed"}:
        raise ValueError("dataset must be Synthetic, Cora, CiteSeer, or PubMed")
    dataset = Planetoid(root=str(Path(root) / name), name=name)
    return dataset[0]


def dataset_summary(data: Data) -> dict[str, int | float]:
    train_size = int(data.train_mask.sum().item())
    train_noise_rate = 0.0
    if train_size > 0 and hasattr(data, "noise_mask"):
        train_noise_rate = float((data.noise_mask & data.train_mask).sum().item() / train_size)
    labels = data.y_true if hasattr(data, "y_true") else data.y
    return {
        "num_nodes": int(data.x.shape[0]),
        "num_edges": int(data.edge_index.shape[1]),
        "num_features": int(data.x.shape[1]),
        "num_classes": int(labels.unique().numel()),
        "train_size": train_size,
        "val_size": int(data.val_mask.sum().item()),
        "test_size": int(data.test_mask.sum().item()),
        "train_noise_rate": train_noise_rate,
    }

        if self.num_nodes <= 0:

        if self.num_classes < 2:

        if self.feature_dim <= 0:

        if self.knn_k <= 0 or self.knn_k >= self.num_nodes:

        if not 0 <= self.label_noise <= 1:

        if min(self.train_ratio, self.val_ratio, self.test_ratio) <= 0:

        if abs((self.train_ratio + self.val_ratio + self.test_ratio) - 1.0) > 1e-6:

def load_config(path: str | Path, overrides: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> StageBConfig:

from __future__ import annotations

import torch
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score


def linear_eval(
    embeddings: torch.Tensor,
    labels: torch.Tensor,
    train_mask: torch.Tensor,
    val_mask: torch.Tensor,
    test_mask: torch.Tensor,
    seed: int,
) -> float:
    del val_mask
    x = embeddings.detach().cpu().numpy()
    y = labels.detach().cpu().numpy()
    train_idx = train_mask.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(bool)
    test_idx = test_mask.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(bool)
    if train_idx.sum() == 0 or test_idx.sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError("train_mask and test_mask must select at least one node")

    clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(x[train_idx], y[train_idx])
    pred = clf.predict(x[test_idx])
    return float(accuracy_score(y[test_idx], pred))
